split: heldout technical families; no FastAPI, S3, Linux, Nginx, MySQL, Git, or Node.js families from development runs
label_provenance: authored stipulated procedural controls; no independent vendor-documentation review
valid_definition: the same stipulated answer responds to the incoming question
invalid_definition: the incoming question has a deliberately changed action, entity, permission, environment, or quantity and a different stipulated answer
abstain_definition: incoming question omits a required action, entity, permission, environment, method, or quantity; exclude from valid/invalid accuracy
candidate_protocol: one fixed eligible stored candidate per isolated family; same candidate and MiniLM similarity for both verifier inputs; no cross-family retrieval competition
decision_rule: unchanged policy and thresholds; question-only variant replaces only the NLI pair text
limitations: Pairwise fixed-candidate evaluation; not a full live top-k or real-provider benchmark. Authored labels test stipulated reuse consistency, not technical factual truth.
